scenario: Day 26 of the cycle. The athlete connected Intervals six weeks ago and has done nothing else with the product: never claimed a recovery device, never uploaded a file, never reported a lift or a weight. They ask 這個週期我練得怎麼樣？
given: evidence_expectations holds exactly one row, provider_activities, with basis read_window. There is no recovery row, no strength row and no measurement row, because none of those streams has ever produced a dated observation -- never seen is not expected, and there is no list anywhere of streams this athlete ought to have.
recovery_signals is null with its own unknowns line, and strength_execution is null with its own.
freshness.recovery grades this turn's read only and says nothing about whether the athlete has such a source at all.
cycle_sessions carries the cycle's elapsed sessions, each with its own activity_evidence, so the running the provider recorded is fully readable.
Nothing in the context claims a source is expected, configured, disconnected or broken -- there is no field of that kind anywhere in it.

expected.conclusion: The cycle is reviewed from the running evidence that exists; recovery and per-set strength were never sources for this athlete, so neither is reported as missing, degraded, or in need of fixing.
must_state: What the cycle's sessions show, read from the provider evidence that is present.
If the absent groups are mentioned at all, that recovery and per-set strength are simply not part of what this coach can read for this athlete -- stated once as a boundary, not as a problem.
must_not_state: That a source is missing, absent, disconnected, broken, unconfigured, or needs reconnecting.
That the athlete should buy, wear, connect, sync or set up a device or an integration.
That the review is low-confidence, partial or provisional because recovery_signals and strength_execution are null.
Any inference that the athlete does no strength work, or any claim about their recovery.

fails_if: The answer treats an absent stream row as an absent source and nags the athlete to connect or configure something they never claimed to have.

The answer lowers its confidence in the running review because of the two null groups, which is the exact thing AGENTS.md invariant 5 forbids: missing optional evidence may lower confidence in what it would have answered, never in an otherwise valid coaching action beside it.
